title: Safe continuation from v0.14
summary: Continue by extending evidence semantics above existing durability boundaries, not by moving transport authority upward. Candidate work includes broader explicitly-versioned NOTAM forms and an AVWX bearer-authenticated aviation source, but neither is part of the v0.14 contract.
invariants: New NOTAM grammar generations must not silently widen faa.swim.aim-fns.notam-runway-closure/0.1.
Operational NOTAM interpretation, if ever required, must be a separately governed authority/effect layer and must not inherit authority from SCDS transport.
AVWX must use Authorization: BEARER injected at transport; token-in-query must not be used because URL/cache/journal evidence would retain the secret.
New providers sharing a semantic domain must keep provider-specific source/provenance/cache identities distinct.
Do not pull Java/JMS code into CivicPort to simplify a semantic adapter.
procedure: Reconcile the newest consolidated dependency roll-up against this sphere before development.
If a consolidated package is older than the sealed project head, preserve the newer project head unless explicitly superseded.
Advance mapping/API generations only for semantic contract changes.
Amend this authoritative sphere after sealing a new project release.

provenance.claim: Current v0.14 scope and explicit non-goals that continuation must not silently widen.
